ios.desc:
PlantGenieAI is your intelligent AI-powered plant care assistant. Simply snap a photo to instantly identify any plant species and receive personalized care tips tailored to your plant's needs. Whether you're a beginner or a green thumb, PlantGenie helps you nurture your indoor and outdoor plants with confidence. Track your plant care history, get reminders for watering and fertilizing, and explore expert advice all in one app.

Join thousands of plant lovers who trust PlantGenie to keep their plants healthy and thriving. Download now and transform your plant care routine!

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I'm a solo builder and a plant lover. I kept struggling to identify my houseplants correctly, and even when I knew their names, I wasn’t always sure how to care for them properly. Watering too much, not enough light… you know the drill.

So I built PlantGenieAI, an iOS app that does four things:

1. Instantly identifies plants from a photo (95%+ accuracy)

2. Gives tailored care guides based on species

3. Lets you chat with an AI assistant — ask anything like:
   “Why are my pothos leaves turning yellow?”
   “How much sunlight does a fiddle leaf fig need?”

4. Smart reminders for watering, fertilizing, and more

I originally built this for myself, but it's now live on the App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/plantgenieai/id6747911595

Would love feedback — on product direction, UX, or growth ideas.

Thanks for reading, and happy plant parenting!
